items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Fats Waller Franz Walla (PHONETIC) played' in the film 'Stormy Weather' as context for the discussion; the interviewee does not mention Franz Walla personally or describe a relationship.

ctx.x: ... we're continuing this discussion of your first work in films, which was in 1943 -- late in the year, in the film, "Stormy Weather" in which Fats Waller Franz Walla (PHONETIC) played.
The man through whom you became associated with this film was Irving Mills, but who was the musical director of the whole show itself?
